info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Payment By Param1-spec
info.description: The Financial Message Analysis API enables users to access detailed payment insights based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows businesses to retrieve financial message data associated with payments, providing critical information for transaction analysis and reporting. Typical consumers include financial analysts and compliance officers who require visibility into payment transactions for auditing and reconciliation purposes. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes and improve their financial operations.

get.summary: Retrieve Financial Message Analysis for a Specific Payment
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the detailed financial message analysis related to a specific payment identified by its unique resource ID (RES-100045). It provides insights and relevant data for further financial processing and assessment.
